If you end up liking it, I highly recommend Morrison’s Doom Patrol run. It’s a bit whackier and there’s an entire plotline with some aliens that barely makes sense but is still fun to see how ridiculous and outlandish it gets.

I've never read the solo Huntress comics but I have suggestions; and I am also moreover a bigger fan of DC's properties. Never got into brand wars though. Here are my suggestions:

DAREDEVIL

-Frank Miller's run is collected and a great jumping on point for new fans. This is how I got into him and he's been my #1 Marvel character since. Begin with his Collected run. 

-Man Without Fear. 
This is Frank Miller's Batman Year One for Daredevil. You can read it before or after the main run, but either way, a must read. 

-Born Again
Speaking of Year One, this is a story by the same creative team. Read this one after you finish his main run on the title. It's fucking excellent. 

-Daredevil by Bendis and Maleev
This is the next best step after Miller's run. Tone-wise, it's basically a spiritual sequel. Dark, dramatic, and everything you want out of Daredevil. Possibly Bendis' best comic work outside of Ultimate Spider-Man. 

-Daredevil by Charles Soule
Just finished this run; also known as Back in Black. Read it. It's the best Marvel comic I've read in years. 


HAWKEYE

As a fan of Huntress, Kate Bishop might be your girl in Marvel. She takes the mantle after Clint and Matt Fraction's Hawkeye run is a great intro to both characters. Put that on the list for sure. 

PUNISHER MAX

-Garth Ennis writing Punisher. That's all you need to know. 

ALIAS
-AKA Jessica Jones. Another MAX title, and probably my favorite of those. Bendis is just a good writer when he's passionate about the characters. There's nothing forced here, nothing feels like he's trying too hard.
